Intuit Selling Mailchimp for $3.68 Billion to Berkshire Hathaway-Backed Bending Spoons

Intuit said selling Mailchimp would allow it to focus on its core products, including Quickbooks, Credit Karma and TurboTax

By

Intuit INTU -1.03 % decrease; down pointing triangle has agreed to sell its email automation platform Mailchimp for $3.68 billion to Bending Spoons BSP -2.55 % decrease; down pointing triangle, the owner of several wayward tech brands that recently attracted a major investment from Berkshire Hathaway BRK.B -0.45 % decrease; down pointing triangle.

The purchase price includes $3.31 billion in cash and $368 million in Bending Spoons stock.
